name: streamer-split
description: Streamer clip: facecam on top, gameplay below (split-vertical), hook title on the seam (<= 7 words, 3 s), hormozi-pop captions, a punch-in every 6 s, light denoise, progress bar, -14 LUFS.

based_on.trial: streamer clip: detect-webcam (facecam top-right) -> split-vertical -> hook -> sfx -> denoise -> progress bar -> punch-in, QC pass

notes: Segments that already use split-vertical (e.g. from `rustler layout detect-webcam`) keep their panes; others get the default panes below (facecam assumed top-right). If the facecam is elsewhere, run `rustler layout detect-webcam <source_id> --clip-id <clip>` first, or pass overrides {"layout": {"params": {"top": {...}, "bottom": {...}}, "force": true}}.
Write the hook title yourself (<= 7 words) with `rustler overlay add-text <clip> "..."` and apply the template again, or pass overrides {"hook": {"text": "..."}}.
A click/whoosh on the hook helps; add your own sound with overrides {"audio": {"sfx": [{"asset": "<sfx asset id>", "at": "start", "volume_db": -6}]}}.
